reuse.why: It reuses extractTagsFromText for tag parsing, but ignores the existing notes table where group notes are stored (NotesButton id=group.id) and adds a new category_groups.notes column instead.

duplication.why: The group_notes join and the `if (isFixedGroup(cat.group_notes)) continue` check are pasted into six actions on top of their already-copied category queries.

placement.why: A schema migration and a new DbCategoryGroup field are introduced for data the tree already keeps in the notes table, so the rule reads from a parallel store no UI writes.

scope.why: Adds a migration and type change the request does not need, and includes unrelated whitespace edits to init.sql (banks and category_groups).

maintainability.why: Two sources of truth for group notes, a column nobody populates, and the rule repeated in six actions make this hard to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: budget/actions.ts reads g.notes from a new category_groups.notes column (migration 1789000000000) instead of the existing notes table keyed by group id.

disguised_duplication.where: The added check and join are repeated verbatim in each action rather than reshaped.

one_place.where: isFixedGroup in budget/actions.ts is the single predicate, called by copyPreviousMonth, setZero, setLastMonthSpending and set3/6/12MonthAvg, though each action still fetches group_notes and applies the skip itself.
